Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: At this step, WebSurfer failed to follow the Planner’s instruction to disambiguate by also searching “Adamstown railway station New South Wales country” and reviewing authoritative NSW sources. Instead, it only ran the generic query, which surfaced mixed results (including the Irish station) and left the ambiguity unresolved. Subsequent steps repeated generic or irrelevant searches (often re-querying Doboy) without refining for the NSW-specific station, demonstrating insufficient disambiguation and redundant querying. This behavior risked an incorrect or unresolved conclusion about whether both stations are in the same country.
